claim_boundary: This matched synthetic study tests whether a persistent causal self-model can infer and use continuity through representation remapping, memory compression, component change, forks, copy traps, and evidence loss without successor identity labels. It does not test phenomenal consciousness, sentience, valence, moral status, subjective experience, or open-world autonomous agency.

multigeneration_lineage_challenges.claim_boundary: This challenge demonstrates recurrence across a finite synthetic lineage. Paired probe opportunities and the task family remain externally specified; no successor identity label is supplied.
